metric_priority_note: Both are primary; AP is especially important under low theft prevalence.
threshold_metrics: Not primary and not required. No threshold may be selected or optimized on the final cohort.
paired_comparisons: LATENT five-seed arithmetic-mean probability minus FULL_48 HGB
LATENT five-seed arithmetic-mean probability minus DIRECT distribution HGB
DIRECT distribution HGB minus FULL_48 HGB

bootstrap.seed_reason: The already-frozen Stage 25B and Stage 26 Study 2 uncertainty policy fixes seed 2502, so it overrides the Stage 27A fallback seed 42.

any_condition: Fewer than 4/5 seeds satisfy both FULL_48 parity margins
Any seed is worse than FULL_48 by more than 0.030 ROC-AUC or 0.060 AP

all_required: LATENT ensemble ROC-AUC delta versus FULL_48 is at least -0.005
LATENT ensemble AP delta versus FULL_48 is at least -0.010
LATENT-minus-FULL paired lower bounds are at least -0.005 ROC-AUC and -0.010 AP
LATENT-minus-DIRECT observed deltas are positive for both ROC-AUC and AP
At least one LATENT-minus-DIRECT observed gain is meaningful: ROC-AUC at least +0.005 or AP at least +0.010, and that metric's paired lower bound is above zero
For the other LATENT-minus-DIRECT metric, the fraction above zero exceeds 0.5 and the interval upper bound is positive
At least 4/5 individual seeds satisfy both FULL_48 parity margins
No concerning seed-collapse condition is present

any_sufficient: LATENT ensemble ROC-AUC delta versus FULL_48 is below -0.015
LATENT ensemble AP delta versus FULL_48 is below -0.030
LATENT-minus-DIRECT observed AP is nonpositive and its paired 95% upper bound is nonpositive
Two or fewer individual seeds satisfy both FULL_48 parity margins
The median seed is materially inferior to FULL_48: ROC-AUC delta below -0.015 or AP delta below -0.030

FINAL_B_PARTIAL_MIXED_FINAL_REPLICATION: Neither every FINAL A condition nor any FINAL C condition is satisfied.
evaluation_order: Compute and persist all frozen predictions and metrics, then apply these criteria mechanically without adaptation.
